entries.Original:
This option will display the current server ID of the instance in chat each time you instance into a Eureka zone. This might help you identify unique instances. However, there are a few things you should note.

First of all, this method is definitely not the best way to uniquely identify Eureka zones.

Secondly, according to sources and self-testing, the server ID may get reused for the new instance after the old instance gets locked.

Examples:
If you enter a Pagos zone with server ID (60) and you rejoin to another Pagos zone with server ID (61), it would have meant that you've just joined another instance.
If a zone in Pyros with server ID (59) gets locked, on very rare occasions, the new Pyros instance might get the same server ID (59) as well.

Thirdly, from what I know and have read (but have been unable to test), these server IDs are unique to people in the same world as you. This means that another person in another world will get a different server ID than what you have.

After reading all this information, I hope that you will use it only for your own good. And I will not be entertaining any feedback mentioning that the server ID is "incorrect".
entries.Translated:
此选项会在你每次进入优雷卡区域时，在聊天中显示该副本的当前服务器 ID。这可能有助于你识别不同的副本。不过，有几点需要注意。

首先，这种方法绝对不是唯一识别优雷卡区域的最佳方式。

其次，根据资料和自测，旧副本锁定后，服务器 ID 可能会被新副本复用。

示例：
如果你进入服务器 ID 为 (60) 的帕戈斯区域，然后重新加入另一个服务器 ID 为 (61) 的帕戈斯区域，这意味着你刚刚加入了另一个副本。
如果皮罗斯区域服务器 ID 为 (59) 的副本被锁定，在极少数情况下，新的皮罗斯副本也可能获得相同的服务器 ID (59)。

第三，据我所知和所读（但无法测试），这些服务器 ID 仅对与你同世界的人唯一。这意味着其他世界的人会获得与你不同的服务器 ID。

阅读完所有这些信息后，希望你能仅将其用于自身利益。我不会理会任何提到服务器 ID“不正确”的反馈。

entries.Original:
Hi there!
This is my first FFXIV plugin, alot of the ideas are shamelessly taken from other plugins.

Welcome to Eureka Helper, a tool to help you on your Eureka Adventures. It offers a small variety of QoL changes and a built-in Eureka Tracker.
For those interested in money making NMs (e.g Cassie, Skoll), you can type /arisu (command name from ABBA discord) for their next weather time window!
entries.Translated:

这是我的第一个 FFXIV 插件，很多想法都是无耻地从其他插件借鉴的。

对于那些对赚钱 NM（例如 Cassie、Skoll）感兴趣的人，你可以输入 /arisu（来自 ABBA discord 的命令名）来查看它们下一次的天气时间窗口！
